args.title: Triage issue 4406
args.body:
File: src/ingest/parser.ts

In src/ingest/parser.ts, text.split("\n") splits the input string by newline. When a file ends with an empty line (or multiple newlines), lines.pop() removes only the last empty string created by the trailing newline. However, if the file ends with a blank line preceded by a newline, text.split("\n") produces two empty strings at the end of the lines array. lines.pop() removes the very last one, leaving the preceding empty string in lines. During iteration, this empty line is parsed into `fields = [""]`, which fails shape validation (fields.length !== header.length) and throws IngestError ("errors.rowShape") for the row just past the last transaction.
